name: Essential Cybersecurity Controls
arabicName: الضوابط الأساسية للأمن السيبراني
scopeSummary: Mandatory minimum cybersecurity baseline for all government agencies and private organizations owning or operating Critical National Infrastructure (CNI) in Saudi Arabia.

sampleControls.title: Cybersecurity Strategy Definition & Formal Approval
sampleControls.description: A documented cybersecurity strategy aligned with organizational goals, regulatory mandates, and risk appetite, formally approved by the head of the organization and reviewed periodically.

sampleControls.title: Dedicated Cybersecurity Function & CISO Role
sampleControls.description: An independent cybersecurity department led by a designated Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) reporting directly to senior executive management or the Board.

sampleControls.title: Complete Hardware and Software Asset Inventory
sampleControls.description: Automated, up-to-date cataloging of all information technology, cloud, network, and operational assets with assigned business owners and criticality ratings.

mapping.iso27001: A.5.9, A.5.10 (Inventory and acceptable use of assets)

sampleControls.title: Strong Cryptography for Data at Rest and in Transit
sampleControls.description: Enforcement of approved cryptographic algorithms (AES-256, TLS 1.3) for all sensitive, financial, and confidential data at rest and in transit across public/private networks.

sampleControls.title: Sovereign Cloud Data Residency & Provider Qualification
sampleControls.description: Cloud service providers hosting Saudi government or critical sector data must be licensed under CST Class C/B and store all data and metadata within the Kingdom.

name: Cloud Cybersecurity Controls
arabicName: ضوابط الأمن السيبراني للحوسبة السحابية
scopeSummary: Specialized cybersecurity controls split into Cloud Service Provider (CSP) obligations and Cloud Service Customer (CSC) obligations to safeguard multi-tenant environments.

domainList: Cloud Tenant Isolation & Cryptographic Key Management

sampleControls.title: Virtualization & Hypervisor Multi-Tenant Isolation
sampleControls.description: Hardware-enforced micro-segmentation and memory boundary protection preventing cross-tenant side-channel leakage across virtual instances.

sampleControls.title: Customer-Controlled Key Management (Bring Your Own Key)
sampleControls.description: Customer organization retains exclusive generation, rotation, and revocation control over master encryption keys stored in FIPS 140-3 Level 3 HSMs.

name: Operational Technology Cybersecurity Controls
arabicName: ضوابط الأمن السيبراني للأنظمة التشغيلية
scopeSummary: Targeted technical specifications for Industrial Control Systems (ICS), SCADA, DCS, and Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS) across critical infrastructure.

domainList: OT Third-Party & Field Service Remote Access

sampleControls.title: Purdue Model Level 3/Level 4 Industrial DMZ Segregation
sampleControls.description: Strict hardware data diodes or next-generation firewalls enforcing one-way telemetry replication between Enterprise IT and OT Purdue Model Levels 0–3.

name: SAMA Cybersecurity Framework (2017)
arabicName: إطار الأمن السيبراني للبنك المركزي السعودي
scopeSummary: Strict cyber defense and resilience standard for all banks, financing companies, payment service providers, and insurance companies operating in Saudi Arabia.

sampleControls.title: Mandatory Multi-Factor Authentication for Core Banking
sampleControls.description: Mandatory cryptographic MFA for all employee administrative access and customer banking transactions, incorporating behavioral anti-fraud telemetry.

name: Personal Data Protection Law (Royal Decree M/19 & Exec Regs)
arabicName: نظام حماية البيانات الشخصية

versionHistory.summaryOfChanges: Initial enactment with strict localized processing and criminal provisions; delayed due to multinational enterprise feedback.
Full alignment with international standards, introducing legitimate interest, Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs), BCRs, and 72h breach notification.

scopeSummary: Comprehensive privacy regime regulating collection, processing, cross-border transfer, and storage of Saudi residents’ personal data with criminal penalties.

sampleControls.title: Cross-Border Data Transfer Adequacy & Safeguards
sampleControls.description: Data controllers may only transfer personal data outside KSA if the recipient jurisdiction provides an adequate level of protection or approved Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) are in place, ensuring no harm to national sovereignty.

name: Ethical AI Principles & Generative AI Guidelines
arabicName: مبادئ وأخلاقيات الذكاء الاصطناعي
scopeSummary: Framework establishing 7 core principles: Fairness, Privacy, Safety, Explainability, Accountability, Reliability, and Social Benefit for all AI/LLM deployments.

domainList: Safety and Security in Algorithmic Inference
Privacy and Data Governance for Model Training

sampleControls.title: Right to Explanation for Automated Decisions
sampleControls.description: Organizations utilizing machine learning or generative models for consequential decisions (e.g. credit, hiring, healthcare) must provide intelligible rationale to affected individuals.

name: Regulations for Space Activities & Ground Stations
arabicName: تنظيم الأنشطة الفضائية والمحطات الأرضية
scopeSummary: Technical licensing, telemetry cyber defense, spectrum management, and security standards for satellite operators, earth stations, and space startups.

domainList: Earth Ground Station Physical & Cyber Security

sampleControls.title: End-to-End Cryptographic Protection for TT&C Uplinks
sampleControls.description: Mandatory post-quantum resistant cryptographic algorithms or certified AES-GCM cipher suites for all satellite Telemetry, Tracking, and Command (TT&C) communication uplinks.

auditTimeline: Annual Audit Cycle (Q4 Mandatory Statutory Attestation)

name: Guidance on Cybersecurity of Medical Devices
arabicName: إرشادات الأمن السيبراني للأجهزة الطبية
auditTimeline: Aligned to Medical Device Marketing Authorization lifecycle & post-market surveillance
scopeSummary: Binding cybersecurity requirements for medical device manufacturers seeking Medical Device Marketing Authorization (MDMA) in Saudi Arabia, covering pre-market design controls, secure software lifecycle, and post-market vulnerability management. Explicitly addresses AI/ML-based medical devices. Referenced global frameworks: FDA premarket cybersecurity guidance and WHO / IMDRF principles.

sampleControls.title: Post-Market Cybersecurity Vulnerability Management
sampleControls.description: Manufacturers must maintain a coordinated vulnerability disclosure process and provide timely security updates for authorized medical devices throughout their supported lifecycle.

name: Information Assurance Standards (ISR / IAS)
arabicName: معايير أمن المعلومات لحكومة دبي
scopeSummary: Comprehensive information security baseline mandatory for all Dubai government departments, semi-government entities, and their private-sector technology contractors.

sampleControls.title: Zero Trust Privileged Access Vaulting and Session Recording
sampleControls.description: All administrative and privileged access to sensitive government infrastructure must pass through an isolated bastion host with just-in-time credential checkout and keystroke logging.

name: Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 on Personal Data Protection
arabicName: مرسوم بقانون اتحادي رقم 45 لسنة 2021 بشأن حماية البيانات الشخصية
scopeSummary: Unified federal law for personal data processing across the UAE onshore jurisdiction, mandating DPIAs, appointing DPOs, and regulating international data exports.

domainList: Breach Reporting to UAE Data Office

sampleControls.title: Mandatory DPIA for AI and Automated Profiling
sampleControls.description: Prior to processing data using new technologies, AI, or automated profiling likely to produce high risks to individuals, controllers must perform and document a DPIA.

name: CBUAE Cyber Risk Management Framework & Standards
arabicName: معايير إدارة مخاطر الأمن السيبراني لمصرف الإمارات المركزي
scopeSummary: Mandatory operational resilience, fraud management, cyber risk oversight, and incident escalation framework for all Licensed Financial Institutions (LFIs) and SVFs.

domainList: Payment Switch & Open Banking API Security

sampleControls.title: CBUAE 2-Hour Cyber Incident Escalation
sampleControls.description: Mandatory notification to CBUAE Cyber Operations within 2 hours of detecting any material cyber breach affecting payment availability, customer data, or capital reserves.

name: ADGM Virtual Asset Regulatory Framework
arabicName: الإطار التنظيمي للأصول الافتراضية في سوق أبوظبي العالمي
scopeSummary: Global benchmark regulation for multilateral crypto trading facilities, custodial service providers, and smart-contract token issuers.

domainList: Smart Contract Verification and Independent Audit

sampleControls.title: Multi-Party Computation (MPC) & Air-Gapped Cold Storage
sampleControls.description: At least 90% of client virtual assets must be held in air-gapped cold storage solutions protected by Multi-Party Computation or hardware HSMs requiring multiple geographically dispersed signers.
sampleControls.clauseReference: FSRA Guidance on Regulation of Virtual Asset Activities Sec. 8.4

name: National AI Strategy & Autonomous Systems Guidelines
arabicName: استراتيجية الإمارات الوطنية للذكاء الاصطناعي 2031
authority: UAE Minister of State for AI, Digital Economy and Remote Work
scopeSummary: Strategic and technical guidelines for safe, bias-free AI deployment in autonomous transport, public services, and enterprise software.

domainList: Safety Bounds in Autonomous Vehicles & Robotics

sampleControls.title: Continuous Evaluation Against Drift and Hallucination
sampleControls.description: AI model pipelines must include automated benchmark suites evaluating semantic drift, safety guardrails, and factual hallucination rates on a scheduled basis.

name: Securities & Commodities Authority Regulatory Framework
arabicName: الإطار التنظيمي لهيئة الأوراق المالية والسلع
auditTimeline: Annual regulatory reporting & periodic supervisory review
scopeSummary: Onshore UAE securities, commodities and capital-markets regulator governing licensed market participants, investor protection, disclosure/ESG standards, technology-governance and data-governance obligations for regulated entities. Aligns with IOSCO principles. Note: the onshore capital markets regime is undergoing reform (Federal Decree-Laws No. 32 and 33 of 2025 establishing the Capital Market Authority); the SCA remains the reference authority for this record. Excludes the DIFC and ADGM financial free zones, which are covered separately.

name: Dubai Health Data Protection & NABIDH Information Security Standards
arabicName: معايير حماية البيانات الصحية وأمن المعلومات - هيئة الصحة بدبي (نابض)
auditTimeline: Annual health information security compliance review (NABIDH participation)
scopeSummary: Dubai-specific health data protection, confidentiality and information-security standards for healthcare providers participating in the NABIDH health information exchange platform. Covers PHI classification, authentication/authorization, incident management and breach notification, interoperability and data-exchange standards. Referenced global frameworks: HIPAA and ISO. Complements the Abu Dhabi ADHICS standard, which is covered separately.

sampleControls.title: PHI Incident Management & Breach Notification
sampleControls.description: Participating healthcare organizations must detect, report and manage incidents and breaches of protected health information (PHI) within the NABIDH platform in accordance with DHA policies and applicable UAE and Dubai law.
sampleControls.clauseReference: NABIDH Policies & Standards - Incident Management & Breach Notification

name: National Information Assurance Policy
arabicName: سياسة ضمان المعلومات الوطنية - دولة قطر

versionHistory.summaryOfChanges: Initial NIA policy issued by Ministry of Transport and Communications (ictQATAR).
Comprehensive modernization by NCSA incorporating Zero Trust, Sovereign Cloud requirements, and 2h Q-CERT incident response SLAs.

scopeSummary: Foundational security baseline mandatory across all government entities, ministries, and designated critical national assets in Qatar.

sampleControls.title: Mandatory Four-Tier Data Classification
sampleControls.description: All electronic and physical data must be formally labeled as Public, Confidential, Secret, or Top Secret, with cryptographic controls applied commensurately.

name: Personal Data Privacy Protection Law (PDPPL)
arabicName: قانون حماية خصوصية البيانات الشخصية رقم 13 لسنة 2016
scopeSummary: Pioneering GCC privacy statute protecting individuals from unauthorized processing of personal data, regulating direct marketing, and restricting cross-border transfers.

sampleControls.title: Explicit Opt-In for Electronic Commercial Communications
sampleControls.description: Prohibition on sending electronic commercial marketing communications to individuals without prior, verifiable, explicit consent and a frictionless 1-click unsubscribe option.

name: QFC Data Protection Regulations & Rules 2021
arabicName: لوائح حماية البيانات في مركz قطر للمال 2021
authority: Qatar Financial Centre Regulatory Authority (QFCRA) / QFC Data Protection Office
auditTimeline: Annual data-protection compliance review under QFC Data Protection Office oversight
scopeSummary: Data protection regime applying to entities incorporated or registered in the Qatar Financial Centre (QFC), operating separately from the State-wide PDPPL (Law No. 13 of 2016). Introduced in 2021 (replacing the 2005 version, effective from mid-2022) with consent requirements, data-subject rights, security obligations, cross-border adequacy determinations and financial penalties. Directly aligned with EU/GDPR standards for financial-centre entities.

sampleControls.title: Right to Access, Rectification, Erasure and Blocking of Personal Data
sampleControls.description: Data controllers within the QFC must enable data subjects to access, rectify, erase and block their personal data in line with the QFC Data Protection Regulations 2021.

name: Information & Communication Security Guide
arabicName: Bilgi ve İletişim Güvenliği Rehberi
authority: Digital Transformation Office of the Presidency (DDO)
scopeSummary: Comprehensive security guide issued under Presidential Circular 2019/12 for all public sector institutions and critical infrastructure operators (Energy, Telco, Transport).

sampleControls.title: Mandatory Isolation of Public Services from Internal Network
sampleControls.description: Public-facing web portals and services must reside in a dedicated multi-tiered Demilitarized Zone (DMZ) with web application firewall (WAF) inspection and strictly filtered backend database access.

name: Personal Data Protection Law (2024 Amendments)
arabicName: Kişisel Verilerin Korunması Kanunu

versionHistory.summaryOfChanges: Initial Turkish data protection law with rigid cross-border consent requirements and separate criminal peace court appeals.
Landmark reform introducing Standard Contracts for cross-border transfers without Board pre-approval, expanded grounds for processing special category data, and administrative court jurisdiction.

scopeSummary: Major 2024 revisions harmonizing Turkish privacy law with EU GDPR regarding cross-border data transfer mechanisms, Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs), and VERBIS registration.

domainList: Processing of General and Sensitive Personal Data
Data Subject Rights & Response Timelines (30 Days)
Data Breach Notification to Board (72 Hours)

sampleControls.title: Updated 2024 Cross-Border Transfer Mechanisms
sampleControls.description: Data transfers abroad may proceed based on an adequacy decision, or where absent, appropriate safeguards such as Standard Contractual Clauses notified to KVKK within 5 business days.
sampleControls.clauseReference: KVKK Law No. 6698 Article 9 (As amended June 2024)

name: Regulation on Information Systems of Banks and Electronic Banking
arabicName: Bankaların Bilgi Sistemleri ve Elektronik Bankacılık Yönetmeliği
scopeSummary: Stringent banking data localization mandate requiring banks’ primary and secondary data centers, core ledgers, and operational recovery systems to be physically sited in Türkiye.

sampleControls.title: Mandatory Domestic Data Center Hosting for Primary and Backup
sampleControls.description: Banks must maintain their primary and secondary data systems, customer transaction records, and cryptographic key stores physically within the Republic of Türkiye borders.

name: Amendments to Capital Markets Law regarding Crypto Assets
arabicName: Kripto Varlık Hizmet Sağlayıcılarına İlişkin Kanun
scopeSummary: Landmark legislation establishing licensing, custody, technical audits, and TÜBİTAK security compliance criteria for all Crypto Asset Service Providers (CASPs) in Türkiye.

domainList: Client Asset Segregation & Licensed Bank Custody

sampleControls.domainName: Client Asset Segregation & Licensed Bank Custody
sampleControls.title: Client Cash Custody in Authorized Banks & Cold Wallet Reserves
sampleControls.description: CASPs must keep fiat deposits in authorized domestic banks and store at least 85% of virtual assets in independent cold wallets audited according to TÜBİTAK cybersecurity criteria.

name: CBB Rulebook - Operational Risk Management & Cyber Security
arabicName: قواعد مصرف البحرين المركزي لإدارة المخاطر التشغيلية
scopeSummary: Detailed supervisory framework governing operational risk, outsourcing to public cloud (AWS Bahrain), business continuity, and incident disclosure.

sampleControls.title: CBB Prior Non-Objection & Cloud Audit Access Rights
sampleControls.description: Licensees must obtain CBB non-objection prior to migrating material IT workloads to the cloud, ensuring full unrestricted audit and examination rights for CBB inspectors.

auditTimeline: Annual Audit Cycle (Q4 Mandatory Statutory Attestation).

name: National Cyber Security Strategy & Governance Standards
arabicName: الاستراتيجية الوطنية للأمن السيبراني - مملكة البحرين
authority: National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) - Kingdom of Bahrain
auditTimeline: Annual national cybersecurity governance review under NCSC oversight
scopeSummary: Bahrain National Cyber Security Strategy led by the National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC), organised around five pillars: strong and resilient cyber defences; effective cyber security governance and standards; building a cyber-aware nation; collective defence through partnership; and cyber workforce development. Includes national cybersecurity awareness and public-sector standards. Referenced global frameworks: NIST and GDPR. Distinct from the Bahrain PDPL (Law 30/2018) and CBB financial-sector rulebook, which are covered separately.

sampleControls.title: National Cyber Security Governance & Standards Adoption
sampleControls.description: Government and critical-sector entities are expected to adopt national cyber security governance standards and align to the NCSC strategic framework.
sampleControls.clauseReference: Bahrain National Cyber Security Strategy, Pillar 2

name: Cyber Security Regulatory Framework
arabicName: إطار تنظيم الأمن السيبراني في دولة الكويت
authority: Communications and Information Technology Regulatory Authority (CITRA)
scopeSummary: Mandatory cybersecurity framework for all telecommunications operators, public bodies, and service providers operating in Kuwait.

sampleControls.title: Telco Core Routing and Gateway Hardening
sampleControls.description: Telecommunications operators must implement BGP route origin authorization (RPKI), anti-DDoS scrubbing clusters, and segregated control plane management.

name: Data Privacy Protection Regulation (DPPR)
arabicName: لائحة حماية خصوصية البيانات
authority: Communications and Information Technology Regulatory Authority (CITRA)
auditTimeline: Annual data-privacy compliance review under CITRA oversight
scopeSummary: Kuwait Data Privacy Protection Regulation, issued by CITRA under Resolution No. 42 of 2021 and applying to public and private sector service providers processing personal data. Mandates explicit consent, data-subject rights, security obligations and breach notification to CITRA. Note: the 2024 update (Resolution No. 26 of 2024) tightened the breach-notification window from 72 hours to 24 hours. Referenced global frameworks: GDPR and ISO 27001. Distinct from the CITRA Cyber Security Regulatory Framework (cyber) and CITRA Cloud Computing Framework, which are covered separately.

sampleControls.title: Personal Data Breach Notification to CITRA
sampleControls.description: Service providers must notify CITRA of a personal data breach within the statutory window (24 hours under the 2024 update; 72 hours under the original 2021 regulation) of becoming aware of the incident.
sampleControls.clauseReference: CITRA DPPR (Resolution 42/2021, as amended by Resolution 26/2024)

name: Central Bank of Egypt Cybersecurity Framework (2021)
arabicName: الإطار التنظيمي للأمن السيبراني للبنك المركزي المصري
scopeSummary: Comprehensive cyber resilience, SOC operations, and threat-hunting framework for state and commercial banks, mobile wallets, and payment aggregators in Egypt.

domainList: Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery, and RTO < 2h

sampleControls.title: Mandatory Dedicated 24/7 SOC and SIEM Ingestion
sampleControls.description: Banks must operate a dedicated 24/7 internal or certified managed Security Operations Center with real-time log ingestion from all payment endpoints and automated alerting to CBE Computer Incident Response Team (EG-FinCIRT).

name: Personal Data Protection Law
arabicName: قانون حماية البيانات الشخصية رقم 151 لسنة 2020
scopeSummary: Egypt’s primary privacy statute establishing licensing for cross-border data transfer, mandatory DPO appointment, and criminal penalties for electronic data misuse.

sampleControls.title: Mandatory PDPC License for International Data Transfers
sampleControls.description: Prohibition on transferring, sharing, or storing personal data collected in Egypt to foreign servers without a formal license or permit issued by the Personal Data Protection Center.

name: Personal Data Protection Law & 2024 Executive Regulations
arabicName: قانون حماية البيانات الشخصية - المرسوم السلطاني 6/2022
authority: Ministry of Transport, Communications and Information Technology (MTCIT)
scopeSummary: Governs processing of personal data in Oman, detailing consent requirements, children’s data safeguards, and cross-border data transfer conditions.

sampleControls.title: MTCIT Authorization for Cross-Border Data Transfers
sampleControls.description: Personal data cannot be processed or transferred outside the Sultanate of Oman without prior explicit approval from MTCIT verifying the foreign state maintains equal protection.

name: National Cybersecurity Strategy & Basic Security Controls
arabicName: الاستراتيجية الوطنية للأمن السيبراني والضوابط الأمنية الأساسية
authority: Ministry of Transport, Communications and Information Technology (MTCIT) / Oman National CERT (OCERT)
auditTimeline: Annual cybersecurity posture review under OCERT / MTCIT national strategy
scopeSummary: Oman national cybersecurity strategy and baseline "Basic Security Controls" issued via the Oman National CERT (OCERT) under MTCIT, establishing minimum security controls (access control, awareness & training, incident response) and e-government security requirements across government and critical sectors. Referenced global frameworks: NIST and ISO 27001. Distinct from the Oman PDPL (Royal Decree 6/2022) and the CBO financial-sector framework, which are covered separately.

sampleControls.title: Baseline Access Control Requirements
sampleControls.description: Government and critical-sector entities must implement baseline access controls, including least-privilege access and authentication safeguards, per the OCERT Basic Security Controls.

name: National Information Security & Cybersecurity Framework
arabicName: الإطار الوطني للأمن السيبراني - المملكة الأردنية الهاشمية
scopeSummary: Unified national baseline enforcing cyber controls across Jordan’s public ministries, banks, telecommunications, and designated critical infrastructures.

sampleControls.title: Quarterly External Vulnerability Assessments & Remediation
sampleControls.description: Critical entities must conduct quarterly vulnerability scans and annual certified third-party penetration tests, reporting critical unpatched exposures to NCSC-JO.

name: Central Bank of Jordan IT Governance, Cybersecurity & Business Continuity Instructions
arabicName: تعليمات حوكمة تقنية المعلومات والأمن السيبراني واستمرارية الأعمال - البنك المركزي الأردني
auditTimeline: Annual IT risk & cybersecurity supervisory review for licensed banks
scopeSummary: Central Bank of Jordan supervisory instructions mandating IT governance, cybersecurity operations, IT risk management and business continuity frameworks for licensed banks and non-banking financial companies operating in Jordan. Referenced global framework: Basel. Complements the national NCSC-JO cybersecurity framework, which is covered separately.

name: Directive Nationale de la Sécurité des Systèmes d’Information
arabicName: التوجيه الوطني لأمن نظم المعلومات وقانون 05-20
authority: Direction Générale de la Sécurité des Systèmes d’Information (DGSSI)
scopeSummary: Mandatory cybersecurity governance and audit regime applicable to all public administrations, local authorities, public establishments, and vital infrastructure operators.

domainList: Gouvernance et organisation de la sécurité
Gestion des risques et classification des actifs
Sécurité des ressources humaines et tiers
Protection des systèmes et contrôle d’accès
Surveillance, détection et gestion des incidents (maCERT)

sampleControls.domainName: Gouvernance et organisation de la sécurité
sampleControls.title: Mandatory Biennial External Security Audit by DGSSI-Approved Providers
sampleControls.description: Critical operators (OIV) must undergo an exhaustive cybersecurity compliance audit every 2 years conducted exclusively by DGSSI-certified cybersecurity service providers (PASSI).

name: Framework for Mandatory Cybersecurity Audits & Cloud Labeling
arabicName: الأمر عدد 17 لسنة 2023 المتعلق بالتدقيق الدوري للسلامة المعلوماتية
scopeSummary: Replaces previous CERT audit decrees, instituting mandatory annual cybersecurity audits for essential entities and establishing national security labels for Cloud providers.

sampleControls.title: Mandatory ANCS Security Label for Public Sector Cloud Hosting
sampleControls.description: Cloud service providers hosting Tunisian public data must hold a valid ANCS security label certifying local data residency, encryption key isolation, and zero foreign extraterritorial access.

name: Critical Systems Cybersecurity Controls
arabicName: ضوابط الأمن السيبراني للأنظمة الحساسة
scopeSummary: Extension to ECC-1:2018 mandating defense-in-depth, zero trust segmentation, continuous behavioral monitoring, and air-gapped backups for high-criticality national systems.

versionHistory.summaryOfChanges: Initial issuance establishing mandatory defense-in-depth controls for systems whose breach would impact national security or economic continuity.

sampleControls.title: Micro-segmentation and Dedicated Critical Zones
sampleControls.description: Critical systems must be isolated in dedicated secure network zones with bidirectional micro-segmentation, zero trust ingress inspection, and privileged jump servers.

name: Data Cybersecurity Controls
arabicName: ضوابط الأمن السيبراني للبيانات
scopeSummary: Prescribes mandatory cryptographic protection, key management (BYOK/HYOK), data lifecycle sanitation, and DLP controls across classified government and enterprise datasets.

versionHistory.summaryOfChanges: Issued to establish unified national data protection standards complement to ECC-1.

sampleControls.title: Cryptographic Key Management and Secure Custody
sampleControls.description: Mandatory use of approved cryptographic algorithms (AES-256, RSA-4096) with HSM-backed key management and dual-custody authorization for classified datasets.

name: Cloud Computing Regulatory Framework
arabicName: الإطار التنظيمي للحوسبة السحابية
scopeSummary: Establishes mandatory registration classes (Class A, B, and C) for Cloud Service Providers (CSPs), mandating sovereign data residency in Saudi Arabia for Level 3/4 content.

versionHistory.summaryOfChanges: Initial cloud regulatory framework.
Revised classification tiers (Class A, B, C) aligning with NCA cloud controls and SDAIA data residency rules.

sampleControls.title: Class C CSP Licensing for Government & Sensitive Workloads
sampleControls.description: Cloud providers hosting Level 3 (Confidential) or Level 4 (Top Secret) Saudi data must obtain formal Class C registration and house all compute, storage, and telemetry in KSA.

mapping.iso27001: A.5.19, A.5.21 (Information security in ICT supply chain)

name: Anti-Cyber Crime Law
arabicName: نظام مكافحة جرائم المعلوماتية
authority: Ministry of Communications and Information Technology / Bureau of Investigation and Public Prosecution
scopeSummary: Core statutory penal law criminalizing unauthorized system access, data interception, denial of service, digital extortion, and financial fraud across all electronic media.

versionHistory.summaryOfChanges: Promulgated by Royal Decree No. M/17 to establish criminal liability for electronic offenses in Saudi Arabia.

sampleControls.title: Penalties for Illegal Eavesdropping and Data Interception
sampleControls.description: Imposes up to one year imprisonment and fines up to SAR 500,000 for spying, intercepting, or receiving data transmitted over an information network without legitimate authorization.

mapping.iso27001: A.5.31 (Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements)

name: Combatting Rumours and Cybercrimes Law
arabicName: مرسوم بقانون اتحادي رقم 34 لسنة 2021 في شأن مكافحة الشائعات والجرائم الإلكترونية
authority: UAE Ministry of Justice / Cyber Security Council
scopeSummary: Landmark federal cybercrime statute with severe sanctions for attacks on critical systems, deepfakes, unapproved virtual asset promotion, ransomware, and commercial VPN bypass.

domainList: Ransomware, Botnets, and Malicious Code Distribution
Electronic Fraud & Unauthorized Virtual Asset Dealings
Identity Theft, Deepfakes, and False Information

versionHistory.summaryOfChanges: Original Federal Law No. 5 of 2012.
Comprehensive replacement modernizing offenses for critical systems, crypto assets, ransomware, and synthetic media.

sampleControls.title: Tampering with Government and Critical Infrastructure Networks
sampleControls.description: Imposes up to life imprisonment and fines up to AED 10,000,000 for unauthorized access, data alteration, or disruption of critical electronic information systems.

name: Abu Dhabi Healthcare Information and Cyber Security Standard
arabicName: معيار أمن المعلومات والأمن السيبراني للرعاية الصحية في أبوظبي
scopeSummary: Mandatory cybersecurity standard for all healthcare providers, insurers, health tech startups, and medical device operators in Abu Dhabi, enforcing strict medical data localization.

domainList: Human Resources & Clinical Staff Cyber Training
Physical & Environmental Security in Clinical Settings
Access Control & Electronic Health Record (EHR) Auditing
Healthcare Incident Management & Reporting to DoH
Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery for Critical Care

versionHistory.summaryOfChanges: Initial ADHICS standard.
Added specific controls for IoMT (Internet of Medical Things), cloud-hosted EHR, and Malaffi health exchange integrations.

sampleControls.title: IoMT and Clinical Medical Device Network Isolation
sampleControls.description: All connected medical devices (infusion pumps, MRI systems, patient monitors) must reside on isolated VLANs with no direct outbound internet route and strict firewall rules.

auditTimeline: Annual Audit Cycle (Q4 Mandatory Statutory Attestation).

name: VARA Custody, Cybersecurity & Technology Rulebook
arabicName: قواعد حفظ الأصول الافتراضية والأمن السيبراني والتكنولوجيا
scopeSummary: Governs Virtual Asset Service Providers (VASPs) in Dubai, mandating cold-wallet cryptographic custody, multi-party computation (MPC) quorum schemes, and threat monitoring.

domainList: Cryptographic Key Management & MPC Quorum Security
Cold vs. Hot Wallet Segregation & Reserve Auditing
Blockchain Node Infrastructure & Smart Contract Audits

versionHistory.summaryOfChanges: Full operational rulebook published by Dubai VARA.

sampleControls.domainName: Cryptographic Key Management & MPC Quorum Security
sampleControls.title: Multi-Party Computation (MPC) and M-of-N Key Sharding
sampleControls.description: VASPs holding client virtual assets must utilize hardware-backed Multi-Party Computation (MPC) or multi-signature schemes where no single party or server holds sufficient key material to initiate transactions.
